metadata.question: Between October 2021 and November 2021, did southern Ethiopia receive less rainfall than northern Ethiopia relative its long-term average for the same months from 2000 to 2013?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use CHIRPS precipitation data (daily, 0.05° resolution) - Two time periods: Oct-Nov 2021 (target) and Oct-Nov 2000-2013 (baseline) - Two regions: Northern Ethiopia (roughly lat 12-14°N) and Southern Ethiopia (roughly lat 4-6°N) 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed (CHIRPS is ground-station + satellite interpolated precipitation) - Just sum precipitation for each period 3. Logic: - Calculate total rainfall for Oct-Nov 2021 for both regions - Calculate average total rainfall for Oct-Nov 2000-2013 for both regions - Compare relative difference: (2021 - baseline)/baseline for each region - If southern Ethiopia has a more negative relative difference (or less positive), answer A - Check for C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (invalid calculations) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define regions const northEthiopia = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([37, 12, 40, 14]); const southEthiopia = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([37, 4, 40, 6]); // Target period: Oct-Nov 2021 const target2021 = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate('2021-10-01', '2021-12-01') .select('precipitation'); // Check if 2021 data exists const size2021 = target2021.size().getInfo(); if (size2021 === 0) { console.log('No CHIRPS data for Oct-Nov 2021'); console.log('C1'); return; } console.log(`2021 Images: ${size2021}`); // Sum precipitation for 2021 const total2021 = target2021.sum(); // Calculate for both regions const north2021 = total2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: northEthiopia, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation'); const south2021 = total2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: southEthiopia, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation'); // Baseline period: Oct-Nov for years 2000-2013 const years = ee.List.sequence(2000, 2013); const baselineCollection = ee.ImageCollection(years.map(function(year) { const col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 10, 1), ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 12, 1)) .select('precipitation') .sum(); return col; })); const sizeBaseline = baselineCollection.size().getInfo(); if (sizeBaseline === 0) { console.log('No CHIRPS data for baseline 2000-2013'); console.log('C1'); return; } console.log(`Baseline years: ${sizeBaseline}`); // Calculate mean of baseline totals const baselineMean = baselineCollection.mean(); const northBaseline = baselineMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: northEthiopia, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation'); const southBaseline = baselineMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: southEthiopia, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation'); // Get values const north2021Val = await north2021.getInfo(); const south2021Val = await south2021.getInfo(); const northBaselineVal = await northBaseline.getInfo(); const southBaselineVal = await southBaseline.getInfo(); // Validation if (north2021Val === null || south2021Val === null || northBaselineVal === null || southBaselineVal === null) { console.log('Calculation returned null values'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (north2021Val < 0 || south2021Val < 0 || northBaselineVal < 0 || southBaselineVal < 0) { console.log('Invalid negative precipitation values'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Calculate relative differences const northRelDiff = (north2021Val - northBaselineVal) / northBaselineVal; const southRelDiff = (south2021Val - southBaselineVal) / southBaselineVal; console.log(`North 2021: ${north2021Val.toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`North Baseline: ${northBaselineVal.toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`North Rel Diff: ${(northRelDiff * 100).toFixed(1)}%`); console.log(`South 2021: ${south2021Val.toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`South Baseline: ${southBaselineVal.toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`South Rel Diff: ${(southRelDiff * 100).toFixed(1)}%`); // Answer: Did southern Ethiopia receive LESS rainfall relative to baseline? // "Less" means more negative or less positive relative difference if (southRelDiff < northRelDiff) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
